messages:
nina: kicked off v3.0.1 canary for generate-eu at 07:08 UTC. variant switched to modelx:batch-kernel-v2 for perf wins.
deploy-bot: Canary progressed 0% -> 100% in 6m. details: https://deploys.redwood.internal/3732101234 :robot_face:
oscar: quick ping 1 1 1 1 1 saw a synthetic gap on gen-heartbeat in eu-west1 at +4m, p95 jumped 90ms -> 420ms.
diana: looking at metrics now. heatmap shows burst of long tail latencies coincident with batching queue depth spikes.
prod-oncall: runbook: if synth p95 > 300ms for >90s AND queue depth > baseline by 2x, pause and consider regional pin.
nina: queue depth spiked x2.7 and we crossed 90s. requesting regional pinback to modelx:batch-kernel-v1 in eu-west1 to limit blast radius.
oscar: agree, do regional pin instead of full rollback. low risk.
smoke-bot: scheduling embed/gen quick probes on eu-west1 (gen-heartbeat, gen-prefill). ETA ~50s.
nina: running pin: `rdctl routes pin --route generate-eu --region eu-west1 --variant modelx:batch-kernel-v1 --reason "batch-kernel-v2 tail latency during canary"`
deploy-bot: Route config patched; rollout id r-2026-06-22-3732.
smoke-bot: probe results posted: gen-heartbeat pre-pin p95 418ms, post-pin p95 105ms. gen-prefill retries down from x4 -> baseline. :white_check_mark:
diana: attaching short flamegraphs in tracker: https://tracker.redwood.internal/INFRA-18421 — looks like batching coalescing caused KV prefetch to be deprioritized for some request shapes.
oscar: adding a monitoring quickcheck to show batching queue depth during rollouts (heatmap) so we catch this earlier.
prod-oncall: holding global rollout for 20m observation window per runbook. update release notes with regional pin and follow-up ticket.
nina: note for release: "v3.0.1 canary: temporarily pinned generate-eu in eu-west1 to modelx:batch-kernel-v1 due to postdeploy synthetic tail-latency correlated with batching queue depth; investigation into batching coalescing ordering opened."
diana: filing issue INFRA-18421 to debug coalescing ordering and prefetch priority. attaching traces and smoke runs.
oscar: will repro in staging with high-concurrency synthetic to iterate on batching threshold tuning.
nina: keeping thread open for 25m; will close if observation window is clean. thanks all. :thumbsup:
